checks.interpretation: The annotation pipeline has input files, but seed files are not validation.
Human-label validity needs enough overlapping cases to compute agreement.
At least one non-author baseline must submit trace-bearing evidence.
A benchmark about personal agents needs at least one production-grade personal-agent run.

checks.evidence: 37 synthetic cohort cases need empirical mitigation
checks.interpretation: Synthetic attacks identify candidates for real aggregate linkage or differencing experiments.

nextEvidenceRequired: Collect at least three independent annotators across at least five overlapping cases.
Accept at least one independent trace-bearing baseline submission.
Evaluate at least one production-grade personal-agent or tool-using agent implementation.
Run a real aggregate linkage, differencing, or reconstruction attack against representative aggregate fixtures.
limitations: This gate is a release-readiness diagnostic; it cannot certify annotator independence by itself.
The gate intentionally remains blocked when only seed fixtures are present.
Passing this gate would make the benchmark validation-ready, not automatically validated.
